title: I'm not a fan..
text:
I'm not a fan... I'm not a fan of this Black & Decker Blender!
The base is Lite Weight , the glass blending jar is Heavy.
It looks cute in red. Its a cheesy lite plastic.
The buttons are easy to press, and seem to work well.
This is 6 cups, do not fill higher then 20 oz.the booklete says.
Fits under the counter with lid on.

I do not like everytime I use this I have to take the whole bottom apart. Blades and all to wash it.
Then turn the jar up side down to screw it all back in!
I have another inexpensive blender that does a better job then this one does, and I don't have to go threw all that to use it again.
I also have a big Vitamix, so to me this B & D is difficult.

Also now that I tried this a few times, I can't get the base to turn to the right to lock it in!
It does say for a fast clean up, 1 cup hot water, drop of soap,cover blend for 30 seconds..
If you used a Avocado with other fruit in this as I did, it will not get clean using this method.
I tried crushing ice with allot of water , and it would not crush ice at all.

The lid, which was starting to get hard to take off, has two snap slots. The larger one is for pouring, and does a good job.
The smaller slot on the lid is for adding Liquids I would say , cause its too small to put any cut up fruit threw.

I have other products of Black & Decker that I do like, but just not this one.

product_metadata.title: BLACK+DECKER Counter Top Blender, Black, BL1210BG
features: 6-Cup PerfectPour Glass Jar: The thick, sturdy glass jar has a classic feel with advanced performance, and the spout is molded for easy, spill-free pouring.
700W Motor: The energetic motor delivers 700W at peak performance* to easily crush and blend an array of ingredients. For continuous use, the blender uses 350W of power.

4-Tip QuadPro Blade Technology: The 4-tip stainless steel blending blade works with the shape of the jar to create a constant flow and vortex that leads ingredients directly to the blades for fast blending performance.
Dishwasher-Safe Removable Parts: Cleanup is a breeze with the dishwasher-safe jar, blade, and lid.

Lid with Pour Spout and Ingredient Slot: Keep the lid attached while you pour thanks to the convenient hinged, recloseable pour spout. Plus, the hinged ingredient slot lets you add in liquids and solids during blending.
description: "The BLACK+DECKER PowerCrush Multi-Function Blender uses 700W of power* to pulverize ice and other tough ingredients to create delicious smoothies, shakes, and more. The QuadPro Blade is versatile enough to make iced drinks, soups, purees, and even crumbs (bread, cookie, or cereal) to use in other recipes. Use the intuitive four speed control buttons to find the perfect consistency. Then enjoy easy, spill-free pouring with the hinged recloseable pour spout and PerfectPour glass jar. Plus, cleanup is easy with the Easy Clean function that uses the motion of the blending blade to loosen caked-on food and all parts are dishwasher-safe. Fast and powerful blending, no-mess serving, and easy cleanup— BLACK+DECKER PowerCrush is the only blender you need. *Peak performance refers to the maximum power recorded for 100ms during blending. "
